findings.summary: New candidate checkpoint state hardcodes parent_run_id to the retained-276 run.
findings.trigger: Worker saves candidate checkpoints at 324, 336, 348, 360, 372, 384 with the literal "D2-retained276-lr3em5-20261026-r2" (runner.py:738). Stale string left over from predecessor; adapt.py does not replace it.
findings.consequence: Every new candidate misattributes its parent run to the retained-276 run. No validator reads parent_run_id (grep: runner.py only; parent_adapter.py, execute_once.py, validate.py, registration_schema.py do not), so no gate fails. Correct lineage is still carried by parent_checkpoint_sha256 (c10d...) and parent_registration_sha256 (8a60...). Fix requires runner.py edit, which changes runner sha256 and registration sha256 (8a9c...) and needs re-freeze; cheap now, impossible after outputs are produced under exclusive-output rules.
findings.recommendation: Repair before launch (new runner sha, new registration, re-run validate.py), or accept and record explicitly that parent_run_id is a stale unvalidated label.

findings.summary: out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) accepts a pre-existing output directory at launch.
findings.trigger: Output dir exists at launch without launch-marker.json (stray or partial directory).
findings.consequence: Preflight does not assert output absence (actual_output_absent is only a one-time validation fact). Launch proceeds into the existing directory; per-file exclusive 'x' writes block name collisions, but unrelated stale files would be swept into artifact-manifest.json at postflight (execute_once.py:360-361).
findings.recommendation: Use exist_ok=False or add an explicit not out.exists() preflight need(). Fails closed before any write.

findings.summary: Launcher preflight requires process-level PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX and dont_write_bytecode, which no frozen artifact records.
findings.trigger: Parent runs `python execute_once.py` without PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=<empty-pycache> and -B (check_import_cache runs in load_registration, execute_once.py:294 and :364).
findings.consequence: ValueError during preflight, before mkdir (execute_once.py:296-297). Fails closed with no output and no marker, but burns an attempt. Only the worker's env is set by the launcher (execute_once.py:325-327).
findings.recommendation: Record the exact launch command and environment in the parent launch runbook. No code change required.

findings.summary: forbidden_outputs ['lr-transition.json'] is declared in the registration but no code path enforces it.
findings.trigger: An lr-transition.json appears in the output dir during a run.
findings.consequence: Postflight (execute_once.py:360-361) writes an artifact manifest but does not compare the output inventory to expected_outputs or forbidden_outputs, so the run would still pass. Nothing in the current code writes that file, so likelihood is low.
findings.recommendation: Optional: assert the output inventory in postflight. Otherwise treat forbidden_outputs as documentation only.
